ideas.pitch: An AI-powered digital safety and phishing triage pipeline built in collaboration with Indore Police priorities to detect, cluster, and analyze regional cyber fraud reports in real-time.
ideas.title: Indore Police Cyber-Shield Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core theme of the hackathon and the official collaboration with Indore Police, solving an immediate real-world digital safety challenge for law enforcement.

ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth personal security agent featuring prompt-injection hardening and automated incident response specifically tailored for securing citizen data against emerging cyber threats.
ideas.title: SovereignAgent Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning architecture of advanced defense-in-depth personal agents while directly serving the emerging technology and cybersecurity tracks.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph intelligence and risk detection platform tailored for tracking suspicious digital financial transactions with built-in bias mitigation for investigative fairness.
ideas.title: FairTrace AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-difficulty graph intelligence and anti-money laundering risk detection, replicating the exact strategy that won first place at major AI innovation hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A governable, offline-resilient emergency coordination mesh network designed for secure communication at the edge during local security incidents.
ideas.title: Aegis-Edge Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents an impressive offline-first hardware and mesh networking solution that stands out visually and functionally in a room full of standard web applications.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated reporting portal allowing whistleblowers and citizens to securely and anonymously submit sensitive digital crime evidence to authorities without leaking identity.
ideas.title: ZK-Witness Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge zero-knowledge cryptography to solve a real digital safety and privacy problem, appealing directly to technical judges looking for hard engineering.
